origin.summary: User wants the current Spring Boot service to act as an MCP server, focused first on /mcp with HTTP tool calling, checking, registration, and update semantics.

events.note: Created from discussion about designing /mcp as the single MCP HTTP endpoint with internal tool registry support.
Implementation began for the /mcp JSON-RPC transport, in-memory tool registry, tool execution, and admin registry methods.
Implemented and verified the MCP HTTP tool registry MVP with Spring MockMvc tests.
